revision_reason: The atom-pooled D denominator was dominated by routine calculations and could conceal exception-identification performance.
name_zh: 排放清单编制综合性能指数-核心版
name_en: Emission Inventory Compilation Performance Index - Core

D.D_regular: Routine source destination, terminal disposition, calculation basis, and pollutant-relevant control decisions after exception terminal decisions are removed.
D.D_exception: Source-level exact exception root-cause set and affected-pollutant terminal-disposition conjunction over the union of expected and actual exception sources.
D.empty_exception_rule: D_exception is NA when neither expected nor actual exceptions exist; D then equals D_regular. Actual-only exception sources make D_exception applicable and score zero.
D.legacy_atom_micro: Reported only as a sensitivity diagnostic; it does not enter D or EICPI_core.

E.anchors: Empirical, source-class-specific seconds per record from Experiment A

aggregation.run_repetitions: Median D_regular and D_exception are combined hierarchically; N and E retain their prespecified medians.
aggregation.source_classes_D: D_regular and D_exception are each averaged across INDUSTRIAL and POWER, then the available components are averaged. Raw D atoms are never pooled across source classes.
aggregation.macro_micro_D: Both reported D values equal the hierarchical component macro; micro D is not an atom-pooled alternative.
aggregation.micro_N: Pooled passed/applicable numeric atoms across source classes.
aggregation.micro_E: Expected target-source-count weighted mean across source classes.

independent_reports.B1: Input-structure semantic retention; does not enter EICPI_core.
independent_reports.B2: Five-class macro-F1 over 26 eligible controlled objects, based on B2-versus-B0 new root cause and disposition; does not enter EICPI_core.
independent_reports.C: Scale/resource profile; does not enter EICPI_core.
independent_reports.D: Ablation-specific D_regular, D_exception, D, and N changes versus same-target Full; no ablation EICPI_core ranking.

reference_interpretation: D and N quantify agreement with the frozen reviewed operational reference, not independent measurement truth.
